episodes.title: A Common Enemy in Evil
episodes.summary: An attack on their camp spurs vampire hunter Richter and young mage Maria to seek the help of the Abbot of Machecoul. Strangers bring news from abroad.

episodes.title: Horror Beyond Nightmares
episodes.summary: As the threat of a Vampire Messiah looms, Tera's past holds dark omens for the future. Annette, Edouard, Richter and Maria head for the château.

episodes.title: Freedom Was Sweeter
episodes.summary: In shock after a loss, Annette shares the story of her escape from slavery and her journey from Saint-Domingue. Chaos erupts at a public gathering.

episodes.title: Horrors Rising from the Earth
episodes.summary: Olrox voices doubts to Mizrak about the Abbot's alliances. Desperate to help a friend, Annette leads a risky mission over Richter's objections.

episodes.title: The Natural Order
episodes.summary: Drolta makes a persuasive pitch to Olrox, and Annette encounters an old enemy. Revelations shed new light on Maria and Richter's family histories.

episodes.title: Guilty Men to Be Judged
episodes.summary: While Richter learns about the Belmont legacy, Annette searches for the wisdom of her own ancestors. Edouard attempts to get through to a comrade.

episodes.title: Blood Is the Only Way
episodes.summary: Emboldened by her victories, the Vampire Messiah steps into the spotlight. Richter flexes new abilities. Olrox makes a surprising proposal.

episodes.title: Devourer of Light
episodes.summary: With the Abbot poised to make an unthinkable sacrifice and Erzsebet's plans already in motion, Richter and his allies hurl themselves into battle.

episodes.title: A Living Legend
episodes.summary: Alucard seeks help from Richter and his friends in the wake of a devastating loss. Elsewhere, Erzsebet makes plans to conquer Paris.

episodes.title: Angel of Death
episodes.summary: Drolta's dark past unfolds as Alucard, Annette and Richter set out in search of Sekhmet's missing soul. Maria encounters her mother in her new form.

episodes.title: The Widow's Window
episodes.summary: As Maria's magic intensifies, Mizrak urges the Abbot to repent and reverse his loyalties. Alucard's party arrives in Paris at the height of revolution.

episodes.title: Monstrous Things
episodes.summary: Annette, Richter and Alucard seek Sekhmet's mummy at the Louvre, where spirits seem to be lighting the way. Juste intervenes in a deadly confrontation.

episodes.title: Into the Abyss
episodes.summary: Maria confronts her dark side as Annette and Richter follow orders to find and destroy the city's undead. Olrox considers his fate in the fight ahead.

episodes.title: Ancestors
episodes.summary: Annette embarks on a perilous journey into the spirit world that sparks a shocking transformation — and sets the stage for an epic showdown.

episodes.title: Grenadye Alaso
episodes.summary: Chaos erupts under a blood-red sky as the battle for Paris begins, with Alucard's allies on one side and Erzsebet's army on the other.

episodes.title: A Line of Great Heroes
episodes.summary: With the future at stake, Richter and friends join forces against a terrifying new evil that puts their powers — and the Belmont legacy — to the test.
